answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce a multi-question generation model (mQG) that generates diverse and contextually relevant questions ... We train mQG with the FairytaleQA dataset, which is constructed for educational purposes ... We also evaluate on TellMeWhy and SQuAD1.1 datasets.

answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L score, BERTScore, and BLEURT to measure the quality of generated questions. For diversity measurement, we use Self-BLEU score ...

answer_4.quote: We hire five annotators, proficient in English as their first foreign language, to further evaluate the diversity and quality of the generated questions. In the question diversity study, we ... rank the three models on a scale of 1 (highest) to 3 (lowest) based on three dimensions of diversity: type, syntax, and content. In the question quality study ... Two dimensions are rated from 1 (worst) to 5 (best): appropriateness and answerability.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank models on diversity (type, syntax, content) and quality (appropriateness, answerability) using a 1‑3 or 1‑5 scale.
